notes.title: Upcoming Changes to Cartoon Survivor
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played Cartoon Survivor so far - we hope you've all been enjoying the cartoon chaos!
We've got some exciting updates to share with the community, which will make purchasing and playing as simple as possible:
Changes to Base Game
Starting next week, from 28th August, the base game of Cartoon Survivor will transition from a free to a paid title. This will also unlock all levels in the game's first two worlds (Jurassic and Prehisteria)

If you already have the base game in your library, this means Cartoon Survivor is yours to keep with no payment required. You'll also be able to play all levels in world one and two - that's 15 free levels!
Individual Worlds + Cheaper DLC Packs
To make sure players can enjoy as much of the game as possible, we've decided to offer each world as an individual DLC pack at a discounted price. Each world in Cartoon Survivor will be available at a cheaper price, and the full set of all 5 worlds will be available as a bundle at a discount. 
Have any Questions?
If you have any questions related to these changes, please don't hesitate to reach out to our team. We are happy to help! You can speak directly with us on the Spunge Games Discord Server, or e-mail us at marketing@spungegames.com
